argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\work'
$dest='E:\work\video2-r25-local'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest){ throw "destination already exists: $dest" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null
git clone --branch agent/media-r25-multicandidate-round-engine-20261004 --single-branch https://github.com/foto6/video2.git $dest
git -C $dest checkout --detach b11a93664f9b64bf6da626119758c841a0a75c1e
$head=(git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$status=(git -C $dest status --porcelain)
[pscustomobject]@{dest=$dest;head=$head;clean=([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace(($status -join '')))} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

note: Create isolated local Media R25 clone at exact frozen head
